t: You're on Oxendon Street, a short street running from Coventry Street in the north down to Orange Street in the south. The name is tied to Henry Oxendon, described as a gambler who made claims on landholdings in the area. The person linked to the name in the records is Sir Henry Oxenden, 1st Baronet, an English politician who sat in the House of Commons at various times between 1645 and 1660.
